description: List a VibeMap project's version-control changesets (most recent first) with a per-changeset op count. Every write you make through this server is wrapped in a changeset, so use this to see the changesets your own edits produced, audit who/what changed the project, or review recent edit history. Pass includeOps=true to inline each changeset's individual operations (entity_type, op, diff).

includeOps.description: Inline each changeset's individual ops + diffs (default false)

name: vibemap_list_changesets
